description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 2044/32 of 09.11.2017, that published  the Rate of Excise Duty (Item No. 2 and 3 as 30% of the payable duty w.e.f. 23.11.2017)
reasoning: This gazette content is an order issued under the Excise (Special Provisions) Act, No. 13 of 1989, amending the rate of Excise duty. It constitutes a regulatory matter involving the modification of existing legislation (a statutory instrument), which falls squarely under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While it names a Minister, it does so only to establish the authority making the order and does not describe his detailed portfolio responsibilities or constitute a personnel change, so it does not qualify for a government-related type (1-3).
